A weapon for someone who won't miss the first time. The personal carry of a certain neon-soaked detective.

Category: Luxury • Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Long Barrel Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 6 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link, Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with capacity modifying attachments. If this weapon was fired during the previous Round in combat, it operates as ROF 2 weapon instead of ROF 1. In addition, the user can sacrifice their Move Action to make this weapon ROF 2 within a Round of combat even if it was not fired during the previous Round. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (5d6). When rolling for damage with this weapon, any damage die which land on a 1 are re-rolled until they result in a higher value.

Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Range: Long Barrel Pistol
Pre-installed: TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link, Power Rebuild, Pistol Long Barrel (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
